messages:
Priya K: FYI escalation from AcmeHealth (INC-5921). Mobile dashboard: legend labels no longer line up with series after pinch/zoom in portrait. Tooltips sometimes show values from a different series. Also seeing missing datapoints for the last ~20m on token_latency_p50 and a bunch of 502s from /api/metrics/tiles in the mobile console.

Priya K: Repro steps I used: 1) Login mobile web (iPhone 13 Safari) -> Open Dashboard 'API Health' -> timeframe last 1h -> pinch to zoom near center -> legend jumps / labels mis-align. 2) Tap a series to highlight -> tooltip shows wrong value for that timestamp. 3) Open remote debug -> network shows repeated GET /api/metrics/tiles?range=1h&res=60 502. Screenshot + HAR: https://redwood.support/attachments/INC-5921/screen1.png (HAR sanitized).

Ethan L: @Priya thanks. Can you paste exact user-agent strings and the raw network response for one of the 502s? Also confirm desktop vs mobile (seems like desktop is OK?).

Priya K: UA samples: iOS Safari: "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1"; Android Chrome: "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; Pixel 6) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/115.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36". Desktop tested on Chrome Mac - no reproduction.
Network response (curl -i):
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "upstream_error",
  "message": "collector timeout"
}
```

Alex R: I pulled infra logs for metrics-collector around the customer's timeline. There are auth errors right after the analytics deploy at 2026-03-15T22:34Z. Example from pod logs: `auth: token exchange failed: 401 invalid_client` then downstream 503/502 returned to api-gateway. I'll try restarting the collector pods to pick up the rotated token; looks like rotation didn't propagate. Command I'm running: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/metrics-collector -n prod` and then tail logs with `kubectl logs -l app=metrics-collector -n prod --since=30m`.

Jin W: Frontend note: the recent analytics-styles PR changed legend ordering and added transform-based animations. On mobile browsers pinch/zoom triggers compositing and can leave the legend calculated positions stale. Two quick candidates: (1) the legend flex-order change + CSS transform causes mismatch when series order is updated during tile decode, (2) the touch pinch causes a paint-layer that doesn't reflow labels. Quick local hack that often helps: add `transform: translateZ(0);` to the chart container and remove `.legend { transform: translateY(...) }` during touch events. I'll prepare a tiny canary patch to disable the transform on mobile touch and force a relayout.

Sam O: Also check the tile payload ordering. If backend started compressing/reshuffling series order for smaller tiles, tooltip mapping (which assumes stable series index -> label mapping) can point at wrong series. I saw a change in tile packing code that could affect ordering when points are sparse. I'll diff the tile encoder output for the past two deploys.

Priya K: Action items: Alex to confirm collector auth and perform restart (assigned). Jin to push canary for mobile touch/legend transform fix to staging and share a build asap (assigned). Sam to verify tile payload ordering and whether series indices changed (assigned). I'll update INC-5921, include repro HAR and notify AcmeHealth with ETA ~2h.

Ethan L: :eyes: Good plan. If collector restart fixes the 502s but legend/tooltip still fail, we should roll the frontend patch quickly. Let me know when staging canary url is up.

Support Bot: Incident INC-5921 status updated -> triaged; assigned_to: support@redwood.ai.

Priya K: Thanks all — I'll follow up after the restart and canary verification. :thumbsup:
